verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents organization collections, members and groups (via the Public API) and an integrated TOTP authenticator, and a team user reports that shared accounts include 2FA. However, no first-party doc explicitly describes sharing TOTP-bearing logins through collections or how per-member permissions work. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of collection sharing with per-member/group permission levels, explicit docs that TOTP seeds travel with shared items, and hands-on admin corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control

citations.quote: The Bitwarden Public API provides organizations a suite of tools for managing members, collections, groups, event logs, and policies.
The killer feature for me has been safer account sharing, including 2FA.
it automatically produces the time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs)
